categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Has IPC label and exclusively modifies IPC infrastructure under src/ipc/libmultiprocess and src/ipc/capnp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a shutdown race condition where in-flight IPC worker calls dereference freed node state and trigger assertion failures like Assert(m_node.chainman). Reliable disconnect and crash-free shutdown are critical to IPC stability.
